headline: New regulation under the Employment Protection Support Program: 3,500 TL monthly support for textile, clothing, leather and furniture sectors
summary: A regulatory amendment offering employment protection and credit support for textile, clothing, leather and furniture manufacturers has taken effect. Applications will be made online.
why: Labour-intensive manufacturing sectors are major employers and exporters in Turkey, so support measures affect production costs and jobs.
